column1: # ESP32-S3 N16R8 (16MB Flash) partition table for the main firmware baby_cry_detector
# Layout: OTA dual-slot (app0/app1 3MB each) + 9.875MB data area
# Replaces huge_app.csv which only covered 4MB (12MB unallocated) and had no OTA slot.
# Why dual slot: an OTA update writes the inactive slot
# otadata pointer and reboots. Power loss mid-write = still boots the old slot
# device cannot be bricked. Cost: 3MB of backup slot sitting idle.
# IMPORTANT: changing the partition table requires a full erase + reflash
#            (pio run -t erase && pio run -t upload) and **wipes NVS** --
#            WiFi credentials and server_url must be provisioned again.
# NOTE: this file MUST stay pure ASCII. PlatformIO parses it with the default
# The data partition is planned-but-unused: the firmware has no filesystem code yet.
# It is reserved for upcoming "cry event audio retention / local logs".
